summary: arista.eos removals: eos_bgp (use eos_bgp_global and eos_bgp_address_family), eos_logging (use eos_logging_global) and the timers.throttle attribute.
questions: Which module do I use instead of eos_logging?

answer_card.title: Removed arista.eos modules
answer_card.answer_md:
- `eos_bgp` removed. Use `eos_bgp_global` and `eos_bgp_address_family`.
- `eos_logging` removed. Use `eos_logging_global`.
- The `timers.throttle` attribute is removed.
